summary: CMS Dynamic Content Conversion Testing - All public pages now fetch data dynamically from CMS APIs. Backend APIs verified with 17 passing tests. Frontend pages (PixelVue Landing, PixelVue Product Detail, Solutions, Solution Detail) all loading correctly from CMS.

minor.issue: Only 2 products have hero_image populated (iPoster, iFlip) - others missing hero images

Loads product from /api/pixelvue/products/{slug}. Shows hero image, quick specs (40mm, 69kg, 16:9, 3840Hz), features with icons, applications, technical specifications from CMS.
Loads 11 solutions from /api/solutions. All solution cards visible with icons, titles, descriptions, and use_case tags from CMS.

Loads solution by slug. Hero section, description, USE CASES (Window Displays, In-Store Signage, etc.), KEY BENEFITS (Increased Foot Traffic, Higher Engagement, Revenue Growth), cross-navigation to prev/next solutions all working.
Returns 24 products with categories: poster (6), commercial (10), creative (8)
Returns individual product with quick_specs, features, applications, specifications. 404 for unknown slugs.
Returns 11 solutions: retail, corporate, outdoor, events, creative, traffic, immersive, transparent, healthcare, education, sports
Admin login API verified working. /admin/pixelvue and /admin/solutions-cms confirmed functional from previous iteration.

PixelVueProductPage.js properly handles loading, error states, and 404 for missing products
